run_mako_plugin: run the mako_plugin function to fill in default binary attributes on a build dictionary
test_mako_plugin: test the mako_plugin function with a sample dictionary containing targets and libs
review_mako_plugin: review the mako_plugin function that sets default platforms and dependency flags on build targets
refactor_mako_plugin: refactor the mako_plugin to support additional optional attributes beyond boringssl, zlib, ares, and gtest
summarize_mako_plugin: summarize the mako_plugin which expands optional binary attributes for gRPC buildgen targets and libs
